entities.summary: Gnaeus Cornelius Lentulus Clodianus was a Roman politician and general who was one of two consuls of the Republic in 72 BC along with Lucius Gellius. Closely linked to the family of Pompey, he is noted for being one of the consular generals who led Roman legions against the slave armies of Spartacus in the Third Servile War.
